thread:
alex: deploy-bot flagged a regression on ranking-service canary after the release to v2.14.0. p95 doubled and a few 504s. deploy-bot recommends autorevert to v2.13.8. change window ends 22:00 UTC. need quick decision.
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary ranking-service p95=720ms (baseline 360ms), errors 0.3%->1.6%. suggested revert: v2.13.8. details: https://telemetry.redwood/canary/3478
maya: is this the new batching change? we enabled batch_heuristic v2 yesterday. any infra signals?
alex: no OOMs, but network retries on host rank-07 increased. batching metrics show longer queue times for small requests.
ops-runner: since canary slice is 8%, we can rollback with minimal blast radius. recommend manual approve so CS/product can prep comms.
product-ops: agree. i'll draft a customer blurb. tag legal if contracts might be impacted.
legal: copied. send us the final blurb and timeline. no immediate SLA flags but file an incident note.
alex: assigning @ops-runner to run rollback: `release rollback --svc ranking-service --to v2.13.8 --slice 8 --strategy rolling`
ops-runner: running now. pausing autoscale on canary: `infractl autoscale set ranking-canary --min 0 --max 0`
ops-runner: revert started. deploy-bot: rollback progress 25% -> 55% -> 100%.
product-ops: draft: "We observed a transient regression in a canary release and rolled back to prior version. No customer data impacted. More info to follow." sending to CSMs.
alex: telemetry after rollback p95=365ms, errors 0.4%. looks good. re-enable autoscale: `infractl autoscale set ranking-canary --min 1 --max 6`
ops-runner: autoscale re-enabled, smoke checks green. kvcache heat restored.
product-ops: sent customer note. legal: incident ticket created.
alex: who owns RCA? maya?
maya: i'll take RCA, will look into batch heuristic and network retries. ETA initial findings 4 hours.
ops-runner: monitoring for 2h with tighter p95 alert. closing thread once RCA ticket created.
alex: thanks everyone. rollback complete and comms sent. :white_check_mark:
